app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. final_report.root_cause: During the incident window the product-catalog service at 10.96.193.65:8080 was refusing TCP connections (TCP RST/ECONNREFUSED). Recommendation repeatedly failed its outbound calls to product-catalog with "Failed to connect to remote host: Connection refused", causing recommendation to return gRPC UNAVAILABLE errors to frontend. Those errors propagated upstream (frontend → frontend-proxy) and explain the user-visible request failures and increased latencies. The frontend and recommendation pods themselves were healthy and listening on their ports; the immediate failure was product-catalog refusing connections.
final_report.evidence_summary: 1) Traces: frontend observed gRPC UNAVAILABLE errors when calling recommendation; frontend-proxy traces show immediate connection refusals to IPs (example: 10.96.80.21:8080). 2) Recommendation pod logs contain repeated grpc._InactiveRpcError/UNAVAILABLE entries including explicit connect errors to ipv4:10.96.193.65:8080: "Failed to connect to remote host: Connection refused". 3) Pod/service inspections: recommendation and frontend pods are Running/Ready and application logs show they are bound and serving traffic; Services have active Endpoints. 4) frontend-proxy logs in the sampled window show successful Envoy startup but did not capture upstream failure lines (likely outside the captured log window or at a different logging level). 5) Cluster snapshot: all services in the namespace have Active Endpoints and all pods are Running, arguing against a namespace-wide outage.
final_report.investigation_summary: Priority-weighted findings: (P1) Verified frontend pod is healthy and actively serving traffic — rules out frontend being down. (P2/P5) Verified proxy/frontend and frontend/recommendation configuration and ports align; Services have endpoints (no port/selector mismatch). (P3) Envoy (frontend-proxy) logs showed normal startup; no upstream failure entries were present in the sampled logs. (P4) Recommendation pod logs show repeated connection refusals to 10.96.193.65:8080 and gRPC UNAVAILABLE errors, establishing that recommendation could not reach product-catalog. (P6) Cluster-level snapshot shows no broad namespace-wide networking outage. Causal chain established: product-catalog refused TCP connections → recommendation outbound calls fail → recommendation returns UNAVAILABLE → frontend errors and higher latency → frontend-proxy sees failing downstream connections and surfaces connection-refused errors in traces. Telemetry exporter errors (otel-collector) were observed as a secondary issue (timeouts/DEADLINE_EXCEEDED) but are not primary cause of application failures.
